notes: Governmental funds modified cash basis: Exhibit E Total Governmental Funds 2023 column (p4); roll on fund balances 395,464 + 900,624 - 965,070 + 347,370 - 97,370 = 581,018. Governmental cash (cash and cash equivalents + cash with county treasurer) and certificates of deposit (investments) from Exhibit C (p3), 2022 comparative column for beginning. Taxes 211,576 split per Schedule 2 (p8; nonmajor funds have no taxes); Intergovernmental revenues 134,385 split per Schedule 2 (p8) plus Library 562 (p11). Capital outlay lines print no function: labelled Capital Outlay. Business-type accrual (Exhibit H Totals, p6; same figures as the Statement of Activities p2), measure net position; Electric transfers out 250,000 to General. Proprietary cash flows from Exhibit I (p7). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position 2023 (p1), capital assets and debt included, so not the funds statement. Detail: Schedule 2 (p8) General and Street; nonmajor combining (pp11-12) per fund column (10 funds; nonmajor functions tie to Exhibit E: public safety = Firemen + Ambulance + Marshall, sanitation = Garbage, culture and recreation = the rest); proprietary per fund from Exhibit H (p6). Schedules 5, 6 and 7 (pp13-15, budget comparisons by fund type in total) are less detailed and not recorded. Read pages 1-15 of 15
